item.title: Demons hit high gear, blow out SUNO by 53
item.description: The Northwestern State men’s basketball team put together its most complete performance of the season Saturday afternoon, rolling past Southern-New Orleans 108–55 on Mike McConathy Court at Prather Coliseum to close non-conference play in decisive fashion. item.description: Talent students at Magnet School performed during the school’s Christmas Program, showcasing their musical skills with a performance of Canon in D by Johann Pachelbel.
